content.caption:
🚀 Most students don't fail DSA because it's hard... they fail because they don't have a roadmap.

When I started learning DSA, the biggest question was:
❓ Which topic should I study first?
❓ Abdul Bari or Striver?
❓ Apna College or Pepcoding?
❓ LeetCode or GeeksforGeeks?
❓ How many hours should I study every day?

I created this 90-Day DSA Roadmap to answer all of these questions.

📚 In this roadmap, you'll get:
✅ Week-by-week DSA plan
✅ Topic-wise learning path
✅ Best resource for every topic
✅ Daily study schedule
✅ Coding platforms to practice on
✅ Beginner → Placement level strategy
✅ Weekly handwritten notes & checklists

🎯 Whether you're starting from zero or preparing for placements, this roadmap will help you stay consistent and avoid wasting time jumping between resources.

💾 Save this post—you'll need it throughout your DSA journey.

📤 Share it with your coding buddy so you can stay accountable together.

💬 Comment "ROADMAP" if you're starting DSA from scratch, and I'll keep bringing the next weeks of the roadmap.

This is just the beginning—I'll be uploading the complete 90-Day DSA Roadmap week by week. Stay consistent, trust the process, and keep coding. 💙

Follow @enginnersdiary for daily DSA notes, placement preparation, Java, interview tips, and coding roadmaps.
